ogni quadratino è un file o un luogo che: every little square is a file or a place the agent may run into. The fog is what it has never seen; dark blue: it saw it mentioned but never opened it (the frontier); light blue: it read it, brighter if it kept coming back; yellow: it edited it; green: it created it. The white trail links the last places it visited, and the blinking square is where it is right now.
ogni punto è un'azione, colorato secondo: every dot is an action, coloured by work phase. Where the dot sits tells you how it is working at that moment: with the default axes, left means exploring and right means building, up means meeting new things, depth means friction. A trail that tightens means it is converging; a dense tangle means it is going round in circles. Drag to rotate.
They are computed over the last 8 actions.
